algorithms.title: Transfer of Command
algorithms.description: Use every time command changes hands.
steps: Incoming officer reports to the command post (face-to-face preferred).
Outgoing IC briefs: situation/size, hazards & safety, objectives & progress, resources assigned/requested, current org chart.
New IC announces the change on the radio to all units and dispatch.
Outgoing IC is reassigned (often to Medical Group or a unit leader role) — never just leaves.

algorithms.title: Building the EMS Org Chart
steps: First EMS unit: IC + global triage.
Add Triage Unit Leader when 2nd unit arrives.
Add Transport Unit Leader early — transport bottlenecks kill MCIs.
Add Treatment Unit Leader once a treatment area is needed.
Add Staging Area Manager once more than a few units are inbound.
When the IC is overloaded or other agencies have big roles: Medical Group Supervisor under Operations; consider Unified Command and Command Staff.
